payload.name: Cria.al
payload.description: 在阿尔巴尼亚寻找租车服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find and compare rental cars for a trip to Albania with Cria.al, a marketplace of local rental companies. Tell ChatGPT where and when you need a car, and it searches live availability at Tirana International Airport, Kukës International Airport and cities across the country, including Tirana, Durrës, Vlorë, Sarandë, Shkodër, Berat, Gjirokastër and Korçë.

Compare whole-trip prices for your exact dates, with the extras you ask for included: full or partial insurance, a child seat, unlimited kilometres, or permission to drive into Montenegro, Kosovo, North Macedonia, Greece, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina or Serbia. Narrow the search by automatic or manual gearbox, car type (from small city cars to SUVs, 4x4s and vans), fuel, number of seats, budget, or cars without a security deposit, and plan one-way rentals between two locations.

For any car, see its specs, photos, deposit, pickup and return locations with delivery fees, the rental company's opening hours and rating, the minimum rental days, the minimum driver age, how long cancellation stays free, the payment methods accepted at pickup and the price of each extra. When you have chosen, you get a link to book that car on cria.al with your trip filled in.

Search works without signing in. The tools read public listings and do not reserve cars, take payments, manage existing reservations or access account information. Availability and the final price are confirmed at checkout on cria.al, and the rental company then accepts or declines the request.
payload.longDescription:
通过Cria.al预订阿尔巴尼亚租车，这是一个本地租车公司的市场。向ChatGPT说明您需要用车的时间和地点，它将实时搜索地拉那国际机场、库克斯国际机场以及全国各城市的租车信息，包括地拉那、都拉斯、发罗拉、萨兰达、斯库台、伯尔特、吉诺卡斯特和科赤的可用情况。

比较您具体日期的全程价格，并包含您要求的附加服务：全险或部分保险、儿童座椅、无限里程或允许驶入黑山、科索沃、北马其顿、希腊、克罗地亚、波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那或塞尔维亚的许可。根据自动或手动变速箱、车型（从小型城市车到SUV、四驱车和面包车）、燃油类型、座位数、预算或无需押金的车辆进行筛选，并规划两地之间的单程租车。

查看每款车型的参数、照片、押金、取还车地点及配送费用，租车公司的营业时间与评分，最低租期、最低驾驶年龄、免费取消时限、提车时接受的支付方式以及各项附加服务的价格。选定车辆后，您将获得一个跳转至cria.al的链接，并自动填入您的行程信息。

搜索功能无需登录即可使用。这些工具仅读取公开列表，不会预订车辆、收取费用、管理现有预订或访问账户信息。可用性和最终价格将在cria.al结账时确认，随后租车公司会接受或拒绝该请求。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search rental cars across Albania, Compare whole-trip prices, Check a car for specific dates, Find pickup and return locations, including airports, Filter by gearbox, car type, seats, fuel, budget and deposit, Plan one-way and cross-border trips, Read vehicle details and rental rules

payload.name: ate
payload.description: 将食物照片保存为贴纸
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ate turns the food you eat into a sticker collection. Send a photo of a meal to ChatGPT and ask ate to save it: ChatGPT names the dish, and ate files it in your collection with its cuisine and the country it comes from. Next time you open the ate app on Android, the dish has been cut out of the photo as a sticker and placed in your collection and on your food map.

You can also ask about what you have eaten: what you had in a city or on a trip, how many cuisines you have tried, or when you last had a dish.

What ate does in ChatGPT:
- Saves a food photo you share to your ate collection, with the date and place you mention.
- Shows a card with the photo, the dish, its cuisine and country, and a button to open the app.
- Answers questions about your collection.

ate only keeps photos of real food. A photo that is not a meal, or shows a whole table of dishes, is not saved, and ChatGPT tells you why. ate never sees the rest of your conversation.

You need an ate account: get the app on Google Play and sign in with the same account when you connect.
payload.longDescription:
ate会将你吃的食物转化为贴纸收藏。向ChatGPT发送餐食照片并请求ate保存：ChatGPT会命名这道菜品，并根据其所属菜系和国家对照片进行归档。下次打开安卓版ate应用时，这道菜品已从照片中裁剪为贴纸，自动归入你的收藏夹和食物地图中。

你也可以询问自己曾吃过的食物：在某个城市或旅行中吃了什么、尝试过多少种菜系，或者上次吃某道菜是什么时候。

在ChatGPT中，ate的功能包括：
- 保存你分享的食物照片至ate收藏夹，并标注你提到的日期和地点
- 展示包含照片、菜品名称、所属菜系和国家的卡片，并附有打开应用的按钮
- 回答关于你收藏内容的问题

ate仅保存真实食物的照片。
若照片不是单道菜品，或显示整桌菜肴，该照片将不会被保存，ChatGPT会告知你具体原因。ate不会查看你对话中的其他内容。

你需要拥有ate账户：在Google Play下载应用，并在连接时使用同一账户登录。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Save food photos to your collection, Look up what you ate and where

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

Paste a listing’s Registration details—region of issuance, licence type and licence number—or provide a registered business name, address or government management number. Verify returns the matching permit’s recorded status, registered business, permit category and address, with source dates and record links when available. payload.name: Tripsy

- “Show me my itinerary for Paris next week.”
- “What reservations do I have on the first day of my trip?”
- “Summarize my upcoming Japan trip.”
- “Help me find gaps in my itinerary.”
- “What activities are planned near my hotel?”
- “Create a day-by-day overview of my trip.”

- Find reservations, activities, notes, and key details faster
- Summarize complex itineraries into simple overviews
- Prepare for travel days with checklists and reminders
- Ask natural-language questions about your saved trip plans
- Get help organizing ideas while building your itinerary

Travel with Tripsy anywhere
Tripsy is also available as a native app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, so you can access and manage your trips during your journey. The native app supports offline access, making your itinerary available even when connectivity is limited.

payload.name: Poker: play, practice, improve
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Play Texas Hold’em poker with an AI opponent, then talk about every hand with ChatGPT. This is more than a poker game. It is a place to play, learn, ask questions, and get better one hand at a time. If you are new to poker, the AI can help you understand what is happening. If you already know the game, you can test ideas, try new plans, and review your choices. Every game becomes a chance to learn.

You can sit down and start playing in just a few moments. The game follows the rules of Texas Hold’em. Cards are dealt, bets are made, and each hand plays out like a real game. When the hand ends, you can ask ChatGPT why something happened. Ask why a bet was good, why a fold was smart, or why a bluff worked. You can keep asking until it makes sense.

Learning poker does not have to feel hard. Big ideas are explained with small, simple words. If you do not know what a flop, turn, river, or blind is, just ask. If you want to know what pot odds mean, ask. If you want help reading the board or choosing between calling, raising, or folding, ask. The AI explains each step in a clear and friendly way.

You are free to play the way you want. Try safe play. Try bold play. Bluff more. Bluff less. See what happens. If something goes well, ask why. If something goes wrong, ask what you could do next time. Every choice is a chance to learn something new.

This is not only for beginners. Players with more experience can explore strategy, compare ideas, and think through tough spots. Talk about hand ranges, position, value betting, drawing hands, and bluff catching. Ask what other lines were possible. Ask what a different player might do. The conversation can go as deep as you want.

There is no rush. Take your time before every move. Think about your cards. Look at the board. Consider what your opponent may have. Then decide. After the hand, talk about the result. Learning happens before, during, and after every game.

Because ChatGPT is part of the experience, every session can be different. You can ask simple questions or difficult ones. You can ask for short answers or longer lessons. You can even ask the AI to explain things as if you are five years old. The game grows with your skill level.

Use this app to practice without the pressure of a real poker table. Try ideas you have never tested before. Make mistakes. Learn from them. Build confidence hand after hand. Poker is a game of skill, patience, and good decisions, and practice helps every player improve.

Whether you want a quick game during a break or a longer session to study strategy, this app is ready. Play a few hands. Play a full game. Stop to ask questions whenever you like. Every conversation helps you understand the game a little better.

If you enjoy games that make you think, if you want to improve at Texas Hold’em, or if you simply want to play poker with an AI that can explain its thinking, this app is made for you. Deal the cards. Make your move. Ask your questions. Learn something new. Then play the next hand with a little more confidence than before.

payload.longDescription: 探索 Pocket FM，全球 #1 音频剧集平台。由人类创意和 AI 创新共同打造、让人一听就停不下来的音频小说，深受全球 200M+ 听众喜爱。探索爱情、恐怖、惊悚和剧情等多种类型的音频剧集。

payload.name: Savecraft
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Savecraft connects your actual game save data to ChatGPT. Instead of describing your character, gear, and progress from memory, Savecraft reads your real save files and game API profiles so the AI can give you specific, personalized advice.

Ask about your build, compare your gear to a guide, check drop rates with exact math, or just talk about your run: ChatGPT already knows your character. Attach notes like build guides or farming checklists, and the AI can track your progress against them over time.

Premade expert reference modules use your save data to coach you. Draft advisors, drop calculators, crop planners, all grounded in real math.
payload.longDescription:
Savecraft 将你真实的游戏存档数据连接到 ChatGPT。AI 无需依靠你凭记忆描述角色、装备和进度，而是读取真实存档文件和游戏 API 个人资料，为你提供具体的个性化建议。

询问配装、将装备与攻略比较、用精确计算核查掉落率，或直接聊聊你的游戏进度：ChatGPT 已了解你的角色。附上配装指南或刷取清单等笔记，AI 还可以持续追踪你的进度。

预制的专家参考模块会使用你的存档数据提供指导，包括配装顾问、掉落计算器和作物规划器，所有建议都基于真实计算。

payload.name: No Bike No Life
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
No Bike No Life beantwortet Motorradfragen mit Daten aus dem NBNL-Katalog.

Kaufberatung: Ein Dialog aus neun Fragen zu Nutzung, Erfahrung, Führerschein, Körpergröße und Budget führt zu passenden Modellen — mit Bild, Eckdaten und Begründung, warum ein Motorrad passt.

Katalog: Modelle suchen, Details ansehen, bis zu fünf Maschinen in einer Tabelle vergleichen.

Routen: Strecken zwischen zwei Punkten oder Rundtouren planen, mit Kurvigkeit, Höhenprofil und dem Wetter entlang der Route auf der Karte.

Wetter: Mehrtägige Vorhersage mit Fahrbarkeits-Bewertung, Zustand der Alpenpässe und ein Kompass, der zeigt, in welche Himmelsrichtung sich die Ausfahrt heute lohnt.

Anfängerwissen: Über 200 beantwortete Einsteigerfragen zu Technik, Wartung und Fahrpraxis.

Alle Angaben stammen aus dem redaktionell gepflegten Katalog von nbnl.de. Modellfotos sind Herstellermaterial und mit Quelle gekennzeichnet.
payload.longDescription:
No Bike No Life 根据 NBNL 目录中的数据回答摩托车相关问题。

购车建议：通过九个问题了解用途、经验、驾照、身高和预算，为你推荐合适车型，并附上图片、关键数据和推荐理由。

目录：搜索车型、查看详情，并在表格中比较最多五辆摩托车。

路线：规划两点之间的路线或环线，可在地图上查看弯道情况、海拔剖面和沿途天气。

天气：查看多日预报和适骑性评估、阿尔卑斯山口路况，以及指南针所示的今日出行方向建议。

新手知识：提供超过 200 个关于技术、保养和骑行实践的新手问题解答。

所有信息均来自 nbnl.de 编辑维护的目录。车型照片由制造商提供，并标明来源。

payload.name: SessionKeeper
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SessionKeeper is a companion app for D&D and tabletop RPG groups. Connect your account to look up session transcripts, summaries, character details, wiki entries, and DM prep notes.. all from within ChatGPT.

Ask what happened in your last game, search your campaign wiki, review character backstories, or pull up DM prep. If you record your sessions with SessionKeeper, all your game data is at your fingertips.
payload.longDescription:
SessionKeeper 是为 D&D 和桌面角色扮演游戏团队提供的配套应用。连接账户后，即可在 ChatGPT 中查阅游戏记录转录、摘要、角色详情、维基条目和 DM 备战笔记。.

询问上一局发生了什么、搜索战役维基、查看角色背景故事，或调出 DM 备战内容。如果你使用 SessionKeeper 录制游戏，所有游戏数据都触手可及。

payload.name: mysaas.lol
payload.description: 寻找相关 SaaS 梗图
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: mysaas.lol helps users choose an existing SaaS, startup, founder, developer, product, sales, or marketing meme for a launch, incident update, release note, newsletter, README, or community post. It returns a visual shortlist with titles, joke explanations, match context, canonical pages, and first-party sharing formats.
payload.longDescription: mysaas.lol 帮助用户为发布、事件更新、版本说明、新闻简报、README 或社区帖子选择现有的 SaaS、创业公司、创始人、开发者、产品、销售或营销梗图。它会返回包含标题、笑点解释、匹配背景、规范页面和官方分享格式的视觉候选列表。

payload.name: Vivid Seats
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find tickets to millions of concerts, sports, comedy, theater, and live events in seconds.

How we can help you:

Browse events - Look for shows or games happening near you (or in any city). Easily plan that perfect night out or a weekend game with friends (e.g. "What shows are happening this weekend")

Find tickets - See what tickets are available with pricing, seat information, and seat views. Find that perfect view right in your budget. (e.g. "What are the best seats under $100?")

Use the Vivid Seats app to find answers to these common event questions and more:
- What shows or events are happening near me?
- What are the best tickets for a show I'm seeing?
- What are the tour dates for a performer or comedian?

Find your next live experience with the Vivid Seats app.
payload.longDescription:
几秒钟内查找数百万场演唱会、体育赛事、喜剧、戏剧和其他现场活动的门票。

我们能提供哪些帮助：

浏览活动 - 查找你附近（或任何城市）正在举办的演出或比赛。轻松安排完美的夜晚，或和朋友一起度过周末比赛日（例如：“这个周末有哪些演出？”）

查找门票 - 查看可购买的门票、价格、座位信息和座位视野。在预算范围内找到视野理想的座位。（例如：“100 美元以下哪些座位最好？”）

使用 Vivid Seats 应用获取以下常见活动问题的答案，以及更多信息：
- 我附近有哪些演出或活动？
- 我准备观看的演出，哪些门票最好？
- 某位表演者或喜剧演员有哪些巡演日期？

使用 Vivid Seats 应用，寻找下一场现场体验。

payload.name: Phish.in
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Phish.in is a free archive of live Phish audience recordings. This legal open source site is carefully maintained by phans to help music lovers discover and enjoy the music of the popular improvisational rock band. Search and browse the database by song, venue, tour, and more. Play audio without leaving ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Phish.in 是一个免费的 Phish 现场观众录音档案。这个合法的开源网站由 Phish 乐迷悉心维护，帮助音乐爱好者发现并欣赏这支知名即兴摇滚乐队的音乐。可按歌曲、场馆、巡演等搜索和浏览数据库，并且无需离开 ChatGPT 即可播放音频。

payload.name: OTTASIA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: OTTASIA answers the question streaming search gets wrong outside the US: where can I legally watch this, HERE? Coverage spans 34 markets (India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Korea, Japan, the Gulf and more, plus the US, UK, Canada and Australia for the diaspora) and 60+ services, including regional platforms global tools miss (JioHotstar, ZEE5, Sun NXT, Aha, Hoichoi, Chorki, ARY Plus, Shahid, Viu, iQIYI). Availability comes from live data, including OTTASIA's own daily catalog scans of local services and free official-YouTube channels for Pakistani dramas. Also answers what's new on any service in any market, and finds titles across languages (English, romanized, or original script).
payload.longDescription: OTTASIA 回答美国以外流媒体搜索常答错的问题：在这里可以合法观看什么？覆盖 34 个市场（印度、巴基斯坦、孟加拉国、印度尼西亚、韩国、日本、海湾地区等，以及面向侨民的美国、英国、加拿大和澳大利亚）和 60 多项服务，包括全球工具常遗漏的区域平台（JioHotstar、ZEE5、Sun NXT、Aha、Hoichoi、Chorki、ARY Plus、Shahid、Viu、iQIYI）。可用性来自实时数据，包括 OTTASIA 每日扫描本地服务目录以及巴基斯坦电视剧的官方免费 YouTube 频道。还可回答任一市场任一服务上的新内容，并按多种语言（英语、罗马化文字或原文脚本）查找影视作品。

payload.name: Magic Tips
payload.description: 寻找迪士尼乐园人少的日期
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Magic Tips turns "when should we go?" into a concrete answer.

Ask for a resort and a month, and you get a daily crowd score from 1 to 10
with the predicted wait-time level for each date — across Disneyland Paris,
Walt Disney World, Disneyland Resort (California), Tokyo Disney Resort,
Hong Kong Disneyland and Shanghai Disney Resort. Scores are built from
historical wait-time observations, school and public holiday calendars,
weather data and seasonal events, then normalised against each park's own
demand range.

It also answers the questions that come next:
• Attraction catalogues per park — minimum height, ride duration, must-do
  flag and community rating
• Which restaurants serve a given dish, searched across every resort
  ("vegan", "turkey leg", "mickey waffle")
• Resort FAQs and a plain-language glossary of planning jargon (Lightning
  Lane, DAS, rope drop), available in 13 languages

Scope and limits, stated plainly: coverage is Disney parks and Disney
Cruise Line — not Universal. The attraction catalogue is static and does
not include live wait times or ride closures. Crowd scores are forecasts,
not guarantees; the methodology and its known limits are published at
https://magic-tips.app/en/methodology

Magic Tips is an independent, fan-made project. It is not affiliated with,
endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected to The Walt Disney
Company or any of its subsidiaries or affiliates. Park, attraction and
character names are trademarks of their respective owners and are used
here only to identify the places this tool covers.
payload.longDescription:
Magic Tips 将“我们什么时候去比较好？”转化为具体答案。

选择度假区和月份，即可查看每天 1 到 10 分的客流评分，以及每个日期的预计等候时间等级，覆盖巴黎迪士尼乐园、华特迪士尼世界、迪士尼乐园度假区（加利福尼亚）、东京迪士尼度假区、香港迪士尼乐园和上海迪士尼度假区。评分根据历史等候时间观测数据、学校和公共假日日历、天气数据及季节性活动生成，并按照各园区自身的客流范围进行标准化。

它还可以回答后续问题：
• 各园区的游乐设施目录——最低身高、乘坐时长、必玩标记和社区评分
• 搜索所有度假区，查找供应特定菜品的餐厅（“纯素”“火鸡腿”“米奇华夫饼”）
• 度假区常见问题，以及用通俗语言解释规划术语的词汇表（Lightning Lane、DAS、rope drop），支持 13 种语言

适用范围和限制如下：覆盖对象为迪士尼乐园和迪士尼邮轮，不包括环球影城。游乐设施目录为静态数据，不含实时等候时间或设施关闭信息。客流评分是预测值，并非保证；方法及已知限制公布于 https://magic-tips.app/en/methodology

Magic Tips 是独立的粉丝制作项目，与华特迪士尼公司或其任何子公司、关联公司均无隶属、认可、赞助或官方关联关系。园区、游乐设施和角色名称均为各自所有者的商标，仅用于标识本工具涵盖的地点。

payload.name: diggercamp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: diggercamp finds music that actually sounds alike. Paste a Bandcamp, YouTube or SoundCloud link and it returns tracks with a similar sound, analysed by rhythm, timbre, key and energy rather than tags or popularity. Dig deeper from a track you love, build a DJ set with key- and tempo-aware matching, find tracks that fit a whole playlist, or generate and save a full set that starts from one track and develops from there. Every result comes with a link to listen on its original source. You sign in with your diggercamp account, and your plan sets the limits.
payload.longDescription: diggercamp 能找到听起来真正相似的音乐。粘贴 Bandcamp、YouTube 或 SoundCloud 链接，它会根据节奏、音色、调性和能量分析并返回相似曲目，而不是依赖标签或热度。深入探索你喜欢的曲目，根据调性和速度匹配来构建 DJ 曲单，寻找适合整张播放列表的曲目，或从一首曲目出发生成并保存一套逐步展开的完整曲单。每项结果都附有原始来源的试听链接。使用 diggercamp 账户登录，具体功能受你的套餐限制。

payload.name: Watchr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Watchr helps people discover TV shows and movies, manage a personal watchlist, track episode progress, rate titles, follow upcoming episodes, and join public discussions.
payload.longDescription: Watchr 帮助用户发现电视剧和电影、管理个人待看清单、追踪剧集进度、为作品评分、关注即将播出的剧集并参与公开讨论。

payload.name: Hockey- Scores+Standings+Stats
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Get NHL scores, schedules, standings, team details, player information, and game updates without leaving your chat. This app brings hockey information right into your conversation. Ask a question in plain English and get a clear answer. You do not need to search many websites or open another app. Everything stays in one place, making it fast and easy to follow the NHL.

Want today’s scores? Just ask. Want tonight’s games? Ask that too. Need the latest standings? The app can show them. You can check team records, player stats, game times, and much more. If you want to know who won, who is playing next, or how your favorite team is doing, simply ask.

The app works like a hockey helper. You can ask short questions or longer ones. You can say things like “Who plays tonight?”, “Did the Oilers win?”, “Show me the Eastern Conference standings,” or “When do the Rangers play next?” The app understands natural language, so you do not have to learn special commands.

Follow one team or every team. Keep up with the regular season, the playoffs, and important games. Find schedules, scores, and standings in seconds. Whether you watch every game or only check in once in a while, the information is easy to find.

Player information is also simple to explore. Ask about a player and learn which team they play for, their position, and other useful details. Compare players, check team matchups, or look up game information before the puck drops.

Need a quick answer during a game? Ask for the live score. Want to know what happened after the game ends? Ask for the final score. Looking ahead? Check upcoming games and schedules. Looking back? Review recent results. The app helps you stay connected all season long.

Everything happens inside your conversation. There is no need to jump between tabs or search through many pages. Just ask another question and keep going. It feels like talking with a friend who always knows what is happening around the NHL.

The app is built to be clear and easy to use. Answers are organized so they are simple to read. Whether you ask one question or many, the goal is to help you find hockey information quickly.

Great for longtime fans. Great for new fans. Great for people learning about hockey. If you know every player, you can dive into detailed information. If you are just starting to watch the NHL, you can ask basic questions and learn as you go.

Use the app to check scores before work, during lunch, after school, or before bed. See who is winning, who is climbing the standings, and what games are coming next. Keep track of your favorite team throughout the season without extra searching.

You can ask about today’s games, tomorrow’s games, team records, conference standings, division standings, schedules, results, matchups, and more. The app is made to help you find hockey information in a simple and friendly way.

Whether you want a fast score check, a full schedule, the latest standings, player information, or answers to everyday NHL questions, this app keeps everything together inside ChatGPT. Ask, explore, and stay up to date with the National Hockey League from one easy conversation.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开聊天，即可获取 NHL 比分、赛程、排名、球队详情、球员信息和比赛更新。此应用将冰球信息直接带入对话。用日常语言提问，就能获得清晰回答。无需搜索多个网站或打开其他应用，一切都集中一处，让关注 NHL 变得快速简单。

想查今天的比分？直接问即可。想知道今晚有哪些比赛？也可以问。需要最新排名？应用可以显示。你还可以查看球队战绩、球员数据、比赛时间等信息。想知道谁赢了、谁接下来要比赛，或你支持的球队近况如何，只需开口询问。

此应用就像冰球小助手。你可以提出简短或较长的问题，例如“今晚谁比赛？”“Oilers 赢了吗？”“显示东部联盟排名”或“Rangers 下一场什么时候比赛？”应用能理解自然语言，无需学习特殊命令。

关注一支或所有球队，了解常规赛、季后赛和重要比赛。几秒钟内查找赛程、比分和排名。无论你每场比赛都看，还是偶尔关注，信息都触手可及。

球员信息也很容易查询。询问某位球员即可了解所属球队、位置和其他有用详情。比较球员、查看球队对阵，或在比赛开始前查询比赛信息。

比赛进行时想快速了解？询问实时比分。比赛结束后想知道结果？查询最终比分。想展望之后赛程？查看即将进行的比赛和日程。想回顾过去？查看近期结果。整个赛季都能随时掌握动态。

所有操作都在对话中完成，无需在标签页之间切换或翻找多个页面。继续提问即可，就像和一位随时了解 NHL 动态的朋友交谈。

应用设计清晰易用，回答也经过整理，便于阅读。无论你问一个问题还是多个问题，目标都是帮你快速找到冰球信息。

适合资深球迷、新球迷以及正在了解冰球的人。如果你熟悉每位球员，可以深入查询详细信息；如果刚开始观看 NHL，也可以从基础问题开始，边问边学。

可以在上班前、午休时、放学后或睡前查看比分，了解谁在获胜、哪支球队排名上升以及接下来有哪些比赛。无需额外搜索，也能在整个赛季跟踪喜爱的球队。

你可以询问今天或明天的比赛、球队战绩、联盟排名、分区排名、赛程、结果、对阵等。此应用旨在以简单友好的方式帮助你查找冰球信息。

无论你想快速查看比分、获取完整赛程、查看最新排名和球员信息，还是询问日常 NHL 问题，都能在 ChatGPT 的一段对话中集中完成。随时提问、探索，并了解国家冰球联盟的最新动态。

payload.name: JamBase
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: JamBase brings live music data into ChatGPT so you can find shows worth your time without juggling ten different ticketing sites. Search concerts and festivals by artist, venue, city, genre, or date with quick shortcuts like "this weekend" or "next weekend." Track when your favorite bands are touring near you, plan trips around festival lineups, find music livestreams, and ask questions like "what's worth seeing in Brooklyn this weekend?" or "are Phish or Khruangbin touring near Chicago this fall?" Answers are grounded in JamBase's catalog of events from dozens of ticketing and venue sources, updated continuously.
payload.longDescription: JamBase 将现场音乐数据带入 ChatGPT，让你无需在十个不同的票务网站间来回切换，就能找到值得一看的演出。按艺人、场馆、城市、流派或日期搜索音乐会和音乐节，还可使用“本周末”或“下周末”等快捷条件。关注喜爱的乐队何时在附近巡演，根据音乐节阵容规划旅行，查找音乐直播，也可以询问“这个周末布鲁克林有什么值得看的演出？”或“Phish 或 Khruangbin 今年秋天会在芝加哥附近巡演吗？”答案基于 JamBase 持续更新的活动目录，信息来自数十个票务和场馆来源。

payload.name: AstroBella Astrology
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask for your birth chart and you get it drawn, not just described. Give a birth date, time and place, and AstroBella Astrology builds the full natal chart and a wheel you can actually explore — click any planet to see its exact degree, the sign and house it falls in, and every aspect it makes.

What you can ask for:

• Your natal chart — every placement, your rising sign and midheaven, the houses and the complete aspect list, with the wheel drawn beside it.

• What's happening right now — the transits currently touching your chart, or a scan of the coming weeks and months that shows the exact date each one peaks and how long it stays in effect.

• You and someone else — a compatibility comparison that lays out every contact between two charts, closest first.

• Quick sky questions — is Mercury retrograde, what sign is the Moon in, when is the next full moon. These need no birth details at all.

If you don't know your birth time, you still get a chart. The app tells you which parts it cannot determine without it — rising sign, midheaven and houses — instead of quietly guessing them.

Birthplaces are matched against a built-in list of over 120,000 towns and cities, so a small home town works as well as a capital. When a name is genuinely shared — Springfield, or the London in Ontario — you are asked which one you mean instead of being guessed at.

Planets are placed at their real degrees rather than rounded into a sign, and every chart is worked out fresh from astronomical data when you ask for it.
payload.longDescription:
请求出生星盘时，你会得到绘制出的星盘，而不仅是文字描述。提供出生日期、时间和地点，AstroBella Astrology 就会生成完整本命星盘，以及可实际探索的星盘轮图：点击任意行星，查看其精确度数、所在星座与宫位，以及形成的每一个相位。

你可以请求：

• 本命星盘：所有星体位置、上升星座、天顶、宫位和完整相位列表，旁边附有绘制的轮图。

• 当前发生的情况：目前作用于你星盘的行运，或查看未来几周、几个月，了解每次行运达到峰值的准确日期及其影响持续时间。

• 你与另一个人：配对比较，列出两张星盘之间的所有关联，最接近精确相位的排在前面。

• 快速天象问题：水星是否逆行、月亮在哪个星座、下次满月何时出现。这些问题完全不需要出生信息。

即使不知道出生时间，也能得到星盘。应用会明确告诉你哪些部分无法在缺少出生时间时确定，例如上升星座、天顶和宫位，而不是悄悄猜测。

出生地点会与内置的超过 120,000 个城镇和城市列表匹配，因此小家乡和首都一样都能使用。当地点确实存在重名，例如 Springfield 或 Ontario 的 London 时，应用会询问你指的是哪一个，而不是擅自猜测。

行星按真实度数定位，而不是粗略归入某个星座；每次你请求星盘，都会根据天文数据重新计算。

payload.name: FICTURN

FICTURN serves fixed story text and does not generate or rewrite the prose on the fly.
